# Sheriyakam
> Doorstep electrical repairs and licensed wiremen in Thalassery, Mahe, and North Malabar. Upfront transparent rate card starting from ₹499 with direct phone confirmation and 30-day workmanship warranty.

## Key Capabilities & Real Facts
- **Direct Wireman Dispatch**: Fast on-site response across Thalassery, Mahe, Dharmadam, Kadirur, Chokli, New Mahe, and Azhiyur.
- **KSELB Certified Wiremen**: 100% of technicians hold valid wireman or supervisor licenses certified by the Kerala State Electricity Licensing Board.
- **Upfront Standard Pricing**: Minimum starting rate of ₹499 for fault diagnostics and switchboard repairs; clear quote approved before any work begins.
- **Pay After Completion**: Pay only after the repair is tested and demonstrated via UPI QR or cash.
- **Workmanship Warranty**: 30-day rework warranty on all labor and service points repaired.
- **Emergency Blackout Response**: Rapid triage for sparking, short circuits, tripping MCBs, and main line power outages.

## Key Services & Starting Rates
- [Fault Inspection & Multimeter Diagnosis](https://sheriyakam.vercel.app/): Comprehensive on-site diagnosis and line testing. Starting at ₹499 (adjustable against approved work).
- [Switchboard, Socket & Plug Repair](https://sheriyakam.vercel.app/): Replacement of sparking switches, burnt sockets, and 16A points. Starting at ₹499.
- [Ceiling & Exhaust Fan Repair / Installation](https://sheriyakam.vercel.app/fan-repair-kerala): Capacitor replacement, bearing noise fix, and new fan mounting. Starting at ₹549.
- [MCB, RCCB & Fuse Box Tripping (DB Triage)](https://sheriyakam.vercel.app/emergency-electrician): Earth leakage trace, short circuit isolation, and breaker replacement. Starting at ₹649.
- [Inverter & Battery Wiring Setup](https://sheriyakam.vercel.app/): Single/double battery DC cabling, changeover switch, and backup load routing. Starting at ₹749.
- [House Wiring, Additional Points & Earthing](https://sheriyakam.vercel.app/house-rewiring-kerala): Concealed conduit wire pulling, earth pit installation, and safety assessment. Starting at ₹899.
- [Emergency Night Breakdown Callout](https://sheriyakam.vercel.app/emergency-electrician): Priority dispatch for urgent power outages and fire hazards. Starting at ₹999.

## Operating Region
- **Active Pilot Zone**: Thalassery, Mahe, Dharmadam, Kadirur, Chokli, New Mahe, and Azhiyur (Kannur & Kozhikode borders).
